articles.titleTr: Citi analisti itiraf etti: "Big Tech öngörülerimiz tutmadı, iyimserlikten vazgeçtik"
articles.summaryTr: Büyük teknoloji (Big Tech) şirketleri ve yapay zeka odaklı hisselerdeki satışlar, Citi'nin yatırım stratejisinde değişikliğe gitmesine yol açtı. Olumlu görüşlerini sonlandırdıklarını açıklayan Citi, güçlü bilançolu şirketlere yönelik tercihlerini ise koruyor.
articles.articleText: Citi analisti itiraf etti: "Big Tech öngörülerimiz tutmadı, iyimserlikten vazgeçtik" Büyük teknoloji (Big Tech) şirketleri ve yapay zeka odaklı hisselerdeki satışlar, Citi'nin yatırım stratejisinde değişikliğe gitmesine yol açtı. Olumlu görüşlerini sonlandırdıklarını açıklayan Citi, güçlü bilançolu şirketlere yönelik tercihlerini ise koruyor. Büyük teknoloji hisselerinden değer hisselerine yönelim Borsalarda son dönemde yaşanan zayıflık, Citi stratejistlerini büyük ölçekli şirketlerin ve büyüme hisselerinin performansına yönelik beklentilerini değiştirmeye yöneltti. Meta da son haftalarda hisseleri zayıf performans gösteren büyük teknoloji şirketleri arasında yer aldı. Citi'nin hisse senedi alım satım stratejisi başkanı Stuart Kaiser, hafta sonunda yayımladığı değerlendirmede, "birçok yapay zeka odaklı hissenin olumlu bir kazanç sezonundan ve yatırımcıların düşük pozisyon almasından fayda göreceği" yönündeki tahmininin tutmadığını kabul etti. Kaiser, "Üçüncü çeyrek kazançları öncesinde, büyük sermayeli büyüme şirketlerine, hiper ölçekli şirketlere ve güçlü bilançolu hisselere olan tercihimizi artırarak olumlu bir bakış açısı benimsedik" dedi. Citi'nin büyüme hisseleri sepeti değer hisselerinin gerisinde kaldı Ancak piyasalarda büyük teknoloji ve büyüme hisselerinden değer hissesi olarak görülen şirketlere doğru bir yönelim yaşandığını belirten Kaiser, Citi'nin taktiksel büyüme hisseleri sepetinin geçen hafta değer hisseleri sepetinin yüzde 4,1 gerisinde kaldığını aktardı. Son bir aylık dönemde iki sepet arasındaki performans farkı yüzde 32'ye ulaştı. Hayal kırıklığı yaratan bilançolar piyasa yönünü değiştirdi Kaiser'e göre piyasanın büyüme hisselerinden değer hisselerine yönelmesi için bir katalizöre ihtiyaç vardı. Bu değişimi tetikleyen gelişme ise beklentileri karşılamayan şirket bilançoları oldu. Kaiser, hisse başına kâr büyüme rakamlarının genel olarak iyi görünmesine rağmen birçok şirketin yüksek piyasa beklentilerinin belirgin şekilde altında kaldığını söyledi. Beklentilerin de yakın geçmişe kıyasla düşük seviyelerde bulunduğunu vurguladı. Büyük ölçekli bulut şirketleri S&P 500'ün gerisinde kaldı Citi'nin değerlendirmesine göre S&P 500 endeksi geçen ay yüzde 1,9 değer kaybetti. Büyük ölçekli bulut hizmeti sağlayıcılarının performansı ise endeksin yüzde 8,7 gerisinde kaldı. Kaiser, düşük yatırımcı pozisyonlanması ile güçlü bilanço beklentilerinin birleşmesinin beklenen sonucu vermediğini belirterek hiper ölçekli şirketler ve büyüme hisselerine yönelik olumlu görüşlerini sonlandırdıklarını açıkladı. Banka, büyüme hisselerine yönelik genel yaklaşımını değiştirirken güçlü bilançolu şirketlere kıyasla zayıf bilançolu hisselerde uzun pozisyon taşımayı sürdürüyor. Kaiser, sağlık sektöründe yapay zeka uygulamalarını büyüme açısından en iyi seçenek olarak gördüklerini de ifade etti. Ara seçimlerin ardından enerji üretiminde rahatlama bekleniyor Kaiser, ABD'deki ara seçimlerin ardından enerji üretimi gibi alanlarda rahatlama yaşanmasını beklediklerini söyledi. Ancak mevcut belirsizliğin bu yönde şimdilik pozisyon almalarına izin vermediğini belirtti. Piyasaların artan enerji maliyetleri, yükselen tahvil getirileri ve genişleyen kredi spreadleri gibi baskılara bir süredir direnç gösterdiğini kaydeden Kaiser, bilanço beklentilerindeki hayal kırıklığının bu riskleri dengelemekte yetersiz kalabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Citi, bu nedenle güçlü bilançolu ve büyük ölçekli şirketlerdeki hisse pozisyonlarını korumayı planlıyor.

articles.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
articles.summary: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.

articles.titleTr: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
articles.summaryTr: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.
articles.articleText: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft. The hackers behind Binance’s $6.3 billion theft have begun converting stolen Solana tokens into Bitcoin after largely emptying the wallets used to launder funds on Tron, according to blockchain investigators. Lookonchain reported Sunday that the hackers had moved 486,970 Solana (SOL) tokens, worth about $46.4 million, and were swapping them for Bitcoin (BTC) through Relay. The activity involves funds that escaped the freezes imposed after Thursday’s theft, the largest in cryptocurrency history. Industry partners, including Tether and Circle, froze about $3 billion in stolen assets, while investigator SomaXBT estimated the attackers still controlled about $3.5 billion. Binance said the attack compromised its hot wallets, with early findings pointing to a hacked employee laptop before investigators identified additional breach points. The exchange began restoring withdrawals Sunday, pledged to cover the losses and has been working with US authorities to trace and recover the stolen assets. Related: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B Chainalysis said Sunday that most of the hackers’ temporary holding wallets on Tron had been emptied as laundering activity expanded to Solana. It put the value of the Tron transfers at about $500 million. The $500 million figure counted transfers during laundering, including repeated movements between wallets, SomaXBT said in response. About $242 million actually left the Tron holding wallets, he said. Chainalysis said Friday that hackers may be using automation to obscure the trail, citing thousands of transactions in a short period. The firm observed funds circulating repeatedly between wallets, sometimes returning to addresses used earlier in the sequence. Source: Chainalysis FBI asks crypto services to block hackers’ transactions Some stolen funds also reached centralized exchange Gate. Lookonchain reported Monday that the hackers had deposited about $250,000 there over the preceding 12 hours. Gate subsequently said it had frozen two linked accounts and would cooperate with law enforcement. Its statement did not specify how much money was frozen. The FBI on Saturday attributed Thursday’s theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor hackers and published wallet addresses linked to the stolen assets. The agency, US Secret Service and IRS Criminal Investigation urged THORChain node operators, exchanges and decentralized finance (DeFi) services to block transactions involving those addresses or funds traced back to them. Investigators had observed the hackers converting stolen assets primarily into Ether (ETH) and expected further laundering through DeFi and instant swap services, the FBI said. Magazine: THORChain founder rejects freeze request, CZ thanks Secret Service: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: Equinor CEO'su açıkladı: Avrupa'da doğal gaz stokları 15 yılın dibinde
articles.summary: Equinor CEO'su, Avrupa'nın kış sezonuna doğal gaz depolarındaki stokların son 15 yılın en düşük seviyesinde girdiğini belirtti. Norveç'ten uzun vadeli gaz tedarik anlaşmalarına talep artarken, sanayi kaynaklı gaz tüketimi beş yıllık ortalamanın yüzde 30 altında kaldı.

articles.titleTr: Equinor CEO'su açıkladı: Avrupa'da doğal gaz stokları 15 yılın dibinde
articles.summaryTr: Equinor CEO'su, Avrupa'nın kış sezonuna doğal gaz depolarındaki stokların son 15 yılın en düşük seviyesinde girdiğini belirtti. Norveç'ten uzun vadeli gaz tedarik anlaşmalarına talep artarken, sanayi kaynaklı gaz tüketimi beş yıllık ortalamanın yüzde 30 altında kaldı.
articles.articleText: Equinor CEO'su açıkladı: Avrupa'da doğal gaz stokları 15 yılın dibinde Equinor CEO'su, Avrupa'nın kış sezonuna doğal gaz depolarındaki stokların son 15 yılın en düşük seviyesinde girdiğini belirtti. Norveç'ten uzun vadeli gaz tedarik anlaşmalarına talep artarken, sanayi kaynaklı gaz tüketimi beş yıllık ortalamanın yüzde 30 altında kaldı. Doğal gaz stokları son 15 yılın en düşük seviyesinde Norveç merkezli enerji şirketi devi Equinor'un Üst Yöneticisi (CEO), Avrupa'nın kış sezonuna doğal gaz depolama seviyeleri bakımından normalden daha kırılgan girdiğini ve kıtadaki gaz stoklarının son 15 yılın en düşük seviyesine gerilediğini belirtti. Müşteri talebi arttı Reuters'ın aktardığı açıklamalara göre CEO, Norveç'ten uzun vadeli doğal gaz tedarik anlaşmalarına yönelik müşteri talebinin arttığını söyledi. Boru hattıyla taşınan doğal gaz için yapılan sözleşmelerin sürelerinin de uzadığını belirten CEO, bu anlaşmaların artık 15 yıl ve daha uzun vadeleri kapsadığını ifade etti. Avrupa'da sanayi amaçlı doğal gaz talebinin son beş yılın ortalamasının yüzde 30 altında kaldığını kaydeden CEO, enerji taşımacılığında nakliye maliyetlerinin de hızla değiştiğine dikkati çekti. CEO, daha önce alışık olunan verimli piyasa koşullarının artık bulunmadığını belirtti.

articles.summaryTr: Fibabanka, 8 Aralık 2025 tarihli Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla kuruluşuna karar verilen Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu için faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunmama kararı aldı. KAP açıklamasında, kararın bankanın mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda alındığı bildirildi.
articles.articleText: Fibabanka, kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlamama kararı aldı - Fibabanka, 8 Aralık 2025 tarihli Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla kuruluşuna karar verilen Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu için faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunmama kararı aldı. - KAP açıklamasında, kararın bankanın mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda alındığı bildirildi. Fibabanka, kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlamama kararı aldığını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bankanın açıklamasına göre, 8 Aralık 2025 tarihli Yönetim Kurulu kararıyla, yüzde 100 iştiraki Fiba Yatırım Menkul Değerler A.Ş.'nin kurucusu ve tek ortağı olacağı Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu Anonim Şirketi'nin kurulmasına karar verilmişti. Söz konusu şirketin kuruluşu için Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'ndan (SPK) izin alınmıştı. Söz konusu KAP açıklamasında şu ifadeler yer aldı: "Bankamızın 08/12/2025 tarihli Yönetim Kurulu kararı ile, Bankamızın %100 pay sahibi olduğu Fiba Yatırım Menkul Değerler A.Ş.'nin kurucusu ve tek ortağı olacağı Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu Anonim Şirketi ("Şirket") unvanlı kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcısının kurulmasına karar verilmiş ve Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu'ndan kuruluş izni alınmıştır. Bununla birlikte, Bankamızın mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda kuruluş iznini takip eden 6 aylık yasal süre içerisinde faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunulmamasına ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlanmamasına karar verilmiştir." Buna göre, Fibabanka, mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda kuruluş iznini takip eden 6 aylık yasal süre içinde faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunmamaya karar verdi. Bu kapsamda Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu aracılığıyla kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlanmayacak.

Bununla birlikte, Bankamızın mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda kuruluş iznini takip eden 6 aylık yasal süre içerisinde faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunulmamasına ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlanmamasına karar verilmiştir." Buna göre, Fibabanka, mevcut stratejik ve operasyonel değerlendirmeleri doğrultusunda kuruluş iznini takip eden 6 aylık yasal süre içinde faaliyet izni başvurusunda bulunmamaya karar verdi. Bu kapsamda Fiba Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu aracılığıyla kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcılığı faaliyetlerine başlanmayacak.

articles.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
articles.summary: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
articles.summaryTr: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.
articles.articleText: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares - Published Ryanair is considering a temporary wage freeze for staff and confirmed airfares will be "materially higher" next summer because of a sharp rise in fuel costs following the US-Israel war with Iran. The airline said it expects fuel prices to remain high "well into 2027" unless there is a "swift resolution" to the conflict. Ryanair said its fuel bill is forecast to be €2bn (£1.6bn) higher in the short-term and its boss, Michael O'Leary, said airfares would have to rise by "double-digits" to help cover the cost. But the firm said that was unlikely to be enough and it is looking into pay freezes. Unite, the union representing Ryanair staff, said it had not been told of "any such proposals". O'Leary also said the company would slow down hiring as airline's costs rise. The airline said its pre-tax profits fell by 16% to €2.4bn during the six months to the end of September, largely due to fuel costs jumping by 15%. The company said that although 80% of its fuel bill had been "hedged" – in effect, bought in advance at fixed prices – the cost of the remainder was elevated. O'Leary reiterated forecasts from earlier this year Ryanair would "need a 20% fare increase" to cover the cost of jet fuel. "I'm not sure we'll get to 20%," he said. "But we're certainly looking at double-digit fare increases across Europe from all airlines in 2027." Aviation fuel prices have surged this year as a result of the US-Israel war with Iran, which has dramatically reduced the supply of refined products coming from the Gulf and increased competition for those produced elsewhere. Ryanair also said it was weighing up freezing pay as "maturing labour agreements" – multi-year wage deals with unions – come to to an end and the policy could be implemented from April next year. Oliver Richardson, national officer at Unite, said the union "hasn't been advised of any such proposals and we have a multi-year pay deal in place which covers next year. A number of Unions across Europe have the same". He said: "Our pay agreement was not attached to, nor dependent on company performance. This was something that the Ryanair was at pains to emphasise. As such we would expect it to be honoured." Ryanair also said it would increase its use of artificial intelligence within its back office and support functions. Meanwhile, Ryanair has cut back on winter flights and said on Monday there would be more to come. It said this was happening across the airline industry, particularly with short-haul carriers. O'Leary said: "We believe those cuts will continue into the summer of 2027. Over the medium term, we expect short-haul capacity will remain constrained out to the early 2030s." - Published11 September - Published21 July

articles.title: İran'dan savaşı sona erdirmek için 7 şart: Kritik pazarlık sürüyor
articles.summary: ABD ve İsrail ile savaşı sona erdirmek için Katar arabuluculuğunda görüşmelerini sürdüren İran, barış için öne sürdüğü 7 şartta ısrar ediyor. Deniz ablukasının kaldırılması, yaptırımların sona ermesi ve Hürmüz Boğazı'nın statüsü kritik pazarlığın merkezinde yer alıyor.

articles.titleTr: İran'dan savaşı sona erdirmek için 7 şart: Kritik pazarlık sürüyor
articles.summaryTr: ABD ve İsrail ile savaşı sona erdirmek için Katar arabuluculuğunda görüşmelerini sürdüren İran, barış için öne sürdüğü 7 şartta ısrar ediyor. Deniz ablukasının kaldırılması, yaptırımların sona ermesi ve Hürmüz Boğazı'nın statüsü kritik pazarlığın merkezinde yer alıyor.
articles.articleText: İran'dan savaşı sona erdirmek için 7 şart: Kritik pazarlık sürüyor - ABD ve İsrail ile savaşı sona erdirmek için Katar arabuluculuğunda görüşmelerini sürdüren İran, barış için öne sürdüğü 7 şartta ısrar ediyor. Deniz ablukasının kaldırılması, yaptırımların sona ermesi ve Hürmüz Boğazı'nın statüsü kritik pazarlığın merkezinde yer alıyor. ABD ve İsrail’in İran’a karşı yürüttüğü savaşı sona erdirmek amacıyla diplomatik temaslar sürüyor. Katar’ın arabuluculuğunda Washington ile Tahran arasında dolaylı görüşmeler yürütülürken, İran yönetimi barış için öne sürdüğü 7 şartın eksiksiz yerine getirilmesini istiyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Katar basınında müzakerelerde ilerleme sağlandığına ilişkin haberler yer alsa da henüz somut bir anlaşmaya varılamadı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın 3 Kasım'daki ara seçimlerin ardından İran'a yönelik yeni bir saldırı kararı alabileceği iddiaları ise bölgedeki gerilimi artırıyor. İran'ın 7 şartı neler? Tahran yönetiminin savaşın sona ermesi için öne çıkardığı talepler şöyle: - ABD'nin İran'a uyguladığı deniz ablukasının kaldırılması. - Yaklaşık 100 milyar dolarlık dondurulmuş İran varlığının serbest bırakılması. - ABD yaptırımlarının kaldırılması ve petrol satışına yönelik muafiyetlerin yeniden uygulanması. - ABD'nin bölgedeki askeri varlığının azaltılması. - Hürmüz Boğazı'nda İran ve Umman tarafından belirlenen yeni geçiş rotasının tanınması. - Lübnan dahil tüm cephelerde çatışmaların durdurulması. - ABD'nin İran'ın iç işlerine müdahalesine ve muhalif gruplarla işbirliğine son vermesi. İranlı yetkililer, taleplerin bir bölümünde Washington'ın olumlu yaklaşım sergilediğini ancak atılan adımların yeterli olmadığını savunuyor. Tahran, şartların karşılanması halinde Hürmüz Boğazı'nı iki gün içerisinde yeniden açabileceğini belirtiyor. Nükleer programda anlaşmazlık sürüyor Görüşmelerin önündeki önemli engellerden biri de İran'ın nükleer programı. Washington, yüzde 60 oranında zenginleştirilmiş yaklaşık 400 kilogram uranyumun seyreltilmesini ve nükleer tesislerin uluslararası denetime açılmasını istiyor. İran ise nükleer konunun mevcut ateşkes görüşmelerinden ayrı tutulması gerektiğini savunuyor. Tahran yönetimi, uranyumun seyreltilmesi seçeneğini tamamen reddetmese de bunun kapsamlı nükleer müzakerelerde ele alınabileceğini ifade ediyor. Taraflar arasındaki görüş ayrılıkları devam ederken, İranlı yetkililer ABD'nin diplomatik söylemindeki yumuşamayı olumlu karşılıyor. Ancak karşılıklı talepler konusunda uzlaşma sağlanamaması, savaşın sona erdirilmesine yönelik belirsizliği sürdürüyor.

articles.title: Londra Borsası'ndan 650 milyon sterlinlik hisse geri alım programı
articles.summary: London Stock Exchange Group, 2026 yılı için açıkladığı 3 milyar sterlinlik hisse geri alım programının son 650 milyon sterlinlik aşamasını başlatıyor. Geri alınan hisselerin tamamı iptal edilecek.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Londra Borsası'ndan 650 milyon sterlinlik hisse geri alım programı
articles.summaryTr: London Stock Exchange Group, 2026 yılı için açıkladığı 3 milyar sterlinlik hisse geri alım programının son 650 milyon sterlinlik aşamasını başlatıyor. Geri alınan hisselerin tamamı iptal edilecek.
articles.articleText: Londra Borsası'ndan 650 milyon sterlinlik hisse geri alım programı - London Stock Exchange Group, 2026 yılı için açıkladığı 3 milyar sterlinlik hisse geri alım programının son 650 milyon sterlinlik aşamasını başlatıyor. - Geri alınan hisselerin tamamı iptal edilecek. Londra merkezli borsa işletmecisi ve piyasa verisi sağlayıcısı London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), 2026 yılına yönelik 3 milyar sterlinlik hisse geri alım programının son aşamasına geçti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 650 milyon sterlinlik son dilimin pazartesi günü başlayacağını ve 24 Şubat'a kadar tamamlanacağını bildirdi. Geri alım işlemleri Citigroup Global Markets tarafından yürütülecek. Şirket, geri alınan hisselerin tamamının iptal edileceğini açıkladı. Önceki 700 milyon sterlinlik geri alım dilimi ise BNP Paribas tarafından gerçekleştirilmişti. 2027 için de geri alım kapasitesi bulunuyor LSEG, geçen ay açıkladığı üçüncü çeyrek sonuçlarında, kredi piyasası verileri sağlayıcısı Octus Intelligence'ı 3,54 milyar sterline satın alma kararına rağmen 2027 yılında 1 milyar ila 1,5 milyar sterlin arasında ek hisse geri alımı yapabilecek kapasiteye sahip olduğunu belirtmişti. Şirket hisseleri 9.478 peni seviyesinde işlem görürken piyasa değeri 45,65 milyar sterlin olarak kaydedildi. LSEG hisseleri son 12 ayda yüzde 0,4 değer kaybetti.

articles.title: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
articles.summary: The country was the first to contribute troops to the AU mission established to stabilise Somalia in 2007.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years
articles.summaryTr: The country was the first to contribute troops to the AU mission established to stabilise Somalia in 2007.
articles.articleText: Uganda begins withdrawing troops from Somalia after 20 years - Published Uganda has begun withdrawing its troops from Somalia after nearly two decades of military involvement in the country. Uganda's acting army spokesperson Chris Magezi on Monday said the first group of troops deployed to Somalia through a bilateral arrangement had already arrived back home and others would follow in a few days' time. He said all forces, including those under the African Union (AU) mission, would exit by the end of 2027 in the phased withdrawal. Uganda was the first African country to deploy troops to Somalia under the African Union Mission in Somalia (Amisom), which was established in 2007 to help protect the country's transitional government from attacks by Islamist militants. A first contingent of 109 Uganda People's Defence Forces (UPDF) troops reportedly left the capital, Mogadishu, on Friday, following an announcement by Uganda's army chief, Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba. Last week, Gen Muhoozi said Uganda had begun pulling out its troops and would hand over security responsibilities to Somali forces. "As we promised, we have started withdrawing UPDF from Somalia. After 20 years of a lot of blood and sacrifice, we are handing over security to our Somali brothers," he wrote on X. On Monday, Magezi said this will mark the end of Uganda's operations in the Horn of Africa country, with Somalia expected to "assume full responsibility for security". The withdrawal comes after Somalia President Sheikh Mohamud met his Ugandan counterpart Yoweri Museveni in a visit to Kampala last week. The meeting was planned to discuss Somalia's security situation as well as trade and economic ties between the two countries. The Somali president reportedly sought to persuade Uganda to extend its military presence in Somalia, although the outcome on this was not made public. In remarks during the visit, Museveni urged Somali leaders and citizens to unite in the fight against al-Shabab militant insurgency. An estimated 4,500 troops are in Somalia under the Africa Union mission, alongside about 2,000 deployed through bilateral arrangements. Somalia has been battling a prolonged and deadly insurgency led by al-Shabab, an al-Qaeda-linked militant group, for more than two decades. Uganda forces first deployed to the country in 2007 and played a key role in driving al-Shabab out of Mogadishu and other major towns. They fought alongside the Somali National Army to recapture strategic territory and secure key government installations. Ugandan troops continued its military involvement under successive Africa Union, including the African Union Transition Mission in Somalia (Atmis), which began with the aim of gradually transferring security responsibilities to Somalia. It was replaced in 2025 by the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (Aussom), which is focused on strengthening Somalia's security institutions and preparing its forces to take full responsibility for the country's security. Aussom now faces uncertainty over its future funding, amid plans to wind down US and UN support. A 12-month transition plan is due to begin to in January, giving Somalia and the AU time to seek alternative sources of funding. articles.titleTr: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured
articles.summaryTr: The attack on Donovan Marx, 50, comes as right-wing groups say there is a genocide of white people - a claim widely discredited.
articles.articleText: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured - Published Warning: This article contains graphic details that some people may find distressing South African police have arrested five people in connection with a brutal attack on a cattle farmer, who was assaulted and tortured in what has been described as a "senseless and barbaric" act. Donovan Marx, 50, was attacked during a house robbery on his farm in Ventersdorp, a small town in South Africa's North West province, last Wednesday. Marx was ambushed as he returned home, shot and stabbed and had his ears cut off in the horrific ordeal, police said. All five of his alleged attackers were arrested over the weekend, a move welcomed by Marx's wife and family. They added that the "legal process must [now] take its course". The horrific attack has caused widespread outrage in a country which is used to high levels of violence. Police last week explained how the attack on Mark happened. A group of masked men armed with guns approached a worker at Mark's house as he was mowing the lawn, they said in a statement. The attackers then demanded to know where Marx was before tying the worker's hands and feet with cable ties. When Marx returned home, police said two of the suspects allegedly approached him and shot him in the upper body. "They [then] dragged him inside the house, tied his hands and feet with cable ties, and allegedly stabbed him." The suspects then ransacked the house and took three firearms from a safe before escaping with Marx's van. The ordeal ended after the farm worker managed to free himself and call for assistance. Marx was rushed to hospital, where he remains, but may need prosthetic ears after surgeons were unable to save his own, local news site IOL reported. South Africa's Agriculture Minister Willie Aucamp condemned the attack on Marx, adding there was no "place in our country for such senseless and barbaric acts". The chair of parliament's police committee, Ian Cameron, praised police for the swift arrests and called for a "strong, properly investigated case" to follow. The five suspects, aged between 26 and 56, will appear in local courts on Tuesday and face house robbery, attempted murder and illegal possession of firearms and ammunition charges. Some right-wing groups have used such attacks on white farmers, who are often from the Afrikaner community, to say there is a genocide against white people in the country - a claim that has been widely discredited. Although the claims have been dismissed by every political party in the country, including those representing Afrikaners, US President Donald Trump has repeated them and has offered white Afrikaners asylum in the US. South Africa's latest crime statistics, covering the period between April and June 2026, do not specify how many attacks took place on farms and only recorded one robbery in a rural area. However, police data show most victims of crime in South Africa, including on farms, are black. articles.summary: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground."

articles.titleTr: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street
articles.summaryTr: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground."
articles.articleText: Nine killed as small jet crashes on Florida street - Published A business jet crashed in a neighbourhood in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, the US transport secretary has said. The crash happened near Cresthaven, some nine miles (14 km) from Mar-a-Lago, President Donald Trump's resort in the wealthy enclave of Palm Beach County, around 12:50 EST (17:50 GMT). Images show a large crater in the middle of a multi-lane road, with fire and debris from the Learjet 60 aircraft scattered across it, but nobody on the ground was hurt. The aircraft had departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said in a statement. Flight analysis indicates that the jet was plummeting hundreds of feet per second before crashing. In air traffic control audio recorded moments before the crash, someone in the cockpit can be heard reporting "moderate turbulence" and that the crew was "managing the ice". The person can then be heard saying the plane was "picking up precipitation" and "we need to climb". Moments later, the same voice said the plane was descending at a rate of 10,000ft (3,048m) per minute. The crew member declared an emergency, yelling "we are in an overspeed condition descending 20,000ft per minute", before saying, "we are going to crash into the ground". About 35 seconds after the initial mayday announcement, the last remark from the cockpit was "we're out of time". Unverified footage posted on social media shows what appears to be a dash-camera recording of the moment of the crash. It shows vehicles driving on a residential suburban street, when suddenly an aircraft nosedives into the ground almost vertically, and explodes into a large fireball. "When you see that video, it's a jarring thing," Florida Governor Ron DeSantis told reporters at a news conference after the crash. "It's like a missile coming down, and a massive explosion, debris going everywhere." It is not yet clear who was aboard the jet when it crashed. DeSantis said "as of now, we don't have any reports of anyone who was on the ground...who was killed or injured". Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash as a "horrific tragedy", and said the FAA was sending a team to the scene to help an investigation by the National Transportation Safety Board. "Please join me in praying for the families and loved ones of those we lost," Duffy added. Palm Beach County Fire Rescue has declared a "mass casualty incident". The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened on Military Trail, a six-lane road that features businesses and restaurants. At a news conference, DeSantis and local officials said that 600 local residents were being evacuated from a nearby trailer-park community. The impact of the crash caused considerable damage to local infrastructure, including its water lines, they said, and it would be at least 30 days before the road re-opened. Thunderstorms had been reported in the area at the time of the crash, and it was heavily raining as the news conference was held. Trump had been at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday morning, and departed from an airport nearby on Air Force One about an hour before the crash.

articles.title: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
articles.summary: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.

articles.titleTr: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
articles.summaryTr: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.
articles.articleText: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences - Published Australian children's author Craig Silvey has been sentenced to seven months in jail for possessing and distributing child exploitation material. In handing down her sentence, Judge Hayley Cormann called Silvey's actions "repulsive" and "degrading". In January, Silvey was arrested after police raided his home in Western Australia and seized several electronic devices. In May, the 44-year-old pleaded guilty to possessing and distributing child exploitation material and in October he was jailed pending his sentencing. The father-of-three is best known for his award-winning young adult novel Jasper Jones and children's book Runt, both of which were later made into movies. "You have devastated and betrayed the trust of thousands of people, and you've let entire communities down," Cormann said on Monday, according to WA Today. Police said Silvey had online chats, in which he discussed child exploitation, open at the moment they turned up to raid his house. In them, the court heard, Silvey had described himself as "extremely open minded" and "obsessed with taboos". He'd discussed his sexual interest in children as young as five with another user of a pornography site, and detectives found images and videos of other adults abusing children on his devices. He was initially charged with four offences, but prosecutors later dropped two. Prosecutors said Silvey contributed to the "cycle of abuse" victimising the children in the images, and argued a harsh sentence was required. However, the author's defence lawyer said he did not have a "sexual interest in children" and was seeking out "the most depraved material" as a form of "emotional" self harm. "His behaviour provided temporary relief from psychological agitation," Eloise Barker said. She said Silvey had displayed genuine remorse for his offending, and that his high profile and the resulting media scrutiny - which lead to his former partner and children relocating interstate - was already a form of punishment. Judge Cormann did not accept many of her arguments, and said Silvey's offending was extremely serious. "These children, the victims of this type of offending, are real and are traumatised… the consequences for them from these abuses are long lasting and very, very traumatic," she said, according to The Australian. Silvey was sentenced to seven months in jail, backdated to 22 October. He is eligible for parole. Silvey's coming-of-age novel Jasper Jones sold more than half a million copies and was awarded the Book of the Year Award by the nation's peak publishing body in 2010. The novel, set in Western Australia with two teenage boys as the main characters, was also shortlisted for the International Dublin Literary Awards and the Miles Franklin Literary Award. It was later turned into a film starring Toni Collette and Hugo Weaving in 2017 as well as a stage play. Another of his acclaimed works is 2022's Runt, about the adventures of an 11-year-old girl and her stray dog and set in the Australia outback. It was also adapted for film in 2024, featuring Celeste Barber. Since his arrest, publishers and book shops have pulled his works from shelves while schools in some states have removed Jasper's books from teaching lists. Related topics - Published13 January

articles.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
articles.summary: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.

articles.titleTr: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack
articles.summaryTr: The exchange froze transactions following the incident which has been linked to a North Korean group.
articles.articleText: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack - Published Binance customers withdrew $3.6bn (£2.7bn) of assets from the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange as it reopened on Sunday following what is believed to be the largest hack in history. The firm suspended all transactions in the wake of the incident, which impacted $6.3bn worth of digital assets. Major organisations, including the US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), have accused North Korea of being responsible for the cyber-attack. The company said it has covered around 95% of the assets stolen in the breach but the remaining amount may take longer to source. Binance has repeatedly said it would cover all of the losses linked to the attack. Binance said on X: "Between 06:00 and 15:30 [GMT] on November 1, we processed $4.649 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits, resulting in a net outflow of approximately $3.64 billion." There was an "initial spike" in withdrawals, which later declined and "are stabilising as expected", it added. Sunday's net withdrawals account for just over 2% of the $171bn of assets under its management, said Binance. The firm said last week that it has reserved more than $6.3bn in funds, to deal with the fallout of the attack. Binance also said withdrawals of more than two dozen major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum have resumed and that more services will resume in phases once security checks are completed. Funds linked to the Binance hack continue to be laundered, according to Alec Zebrick, senior manager in global services at Chainalysis, which has been working with the firm and governments to get the stolen money back. "We continue to see funds being laundered quite actively," he told the BBC's Today Programme. "The attackers are layering these funds across many thousands of addresses, across thousands of deposits," he added. - AI discovered a massive cyber-security flaw - here's what happened - Published22 October The attack on Binance has been attributed to TraderTraitor, a North Korean cybercrime group also known as the Lazarus Group, which stole a then-record $1.5bn from crypto exchange Bybit in 2025. The FBI on Saturday published a list of cryptocurrency wallet addresses linked to the group and urged partners in the industry to help by blocking transactions involving them. The exchange scrambled to urge cryptocurrency issuers to freeze affected assets. Binance said last week that early checks suggest the incident may have started with a compromised laptop that belonged to an engineer, allowing hackers to find a way to make unauthorised transactions. The hack hit Binance's global centralised exchange, Binance.com, while its US-facing platform has said it was not affected by the issue. Binance said it had replaced customers' assets using a combination of sources, including its corporate treasury as well as its futures insurance and emergency reserve funds. "Our commitment remains the same: Binance will fully cover the financial impact of the funds stolen in this incident," the firm said. Cryptocurrencies are digital assets traded on exchanges such as Binance. Unlike cash, they do not exist in physical form and are managed on computers, smartphones and other digital devices. Binance was founded in China and has hundreds of millions of registered users globally. Get our flagship newsletter with all the headlines you need to start the day. Sign up here.

articles.title: Christmas donations gift demand up, charities say
articles.summary: Charities collecting Christmas presents for struggling families say demand has gone up.

articles.titleTr: Christmas donations gift demand up, charities say
articles.summaryTr: Charities collecting Christmas presents for struggling families say demand has gone up.
articles.articleText: Christmas donations gift demand up, charities say - Published Charities giving Christmas presents to struggling families say more children need their help - but they are getting fewer donations this year. The Chard Christmas Present Appeal said it was having to deal with a high-than-normal demand this year, and blamed the problem on more people struggling financially. Martyna Lee, founder of the appeal, said a lot of families were worried about affording presents for their children due to the cost of living crisis and have "tears in their eyes" when the charity can help them. She added: "We are getting more referrals and less donations because of cost of living, so we do struggle. Cost of living is going to get harder and harder." More from Somerset - Song urges builders to talk about mental health - Published8 hours ago - MP facing voice loss after surgery shows recovery signs - Published1 day ago - Bid launched for 410 new homes near motorway - Published1 day ago Lee started the appeal by herself in 2019 from her living room as part of the Lord's Larder food bank in Chard. They rely completely on donations and do not receive any funding. "With one family, the social worker asked the children what they would like for Christmas and they asked for pencils and a colouring book," Lee said. "That broke my heart. They weren't asking for expensive gifts. "So I made sure they had a large gift package, including board games." She added that another family she remembers had a fire at their home just before Christmas and they lost "nearly everything". "We managed to get them fantastic gifts and a Christmas tree and decorations," Lee said. 'More requests' Meanwhile, Taunton's charity appeal Christmas Sparkle said their demand has risen sharply over the last couple of years, with 500 presents given out in 2015 to 10,000 last year. They said they are expecting even higher demand this year. Gill Harrison, founder and manager at Christmas Sparkle, said she believes the cost of living crisis is increasing the demand for their services. "When we started the project in 2015, we gave out 500 individual gifts. Last year, it was around 2,300 parcels, that's about 10,000 individual gifts," Harrison said. "We are expecting possibly even more requests this year. That's mostly because of the cost-of-living crisis." Harrison said they work with schools, social services, police, women's refuges and community nursing teams, which have all increased their referrals to Christmas Sparkle over the last few years. "We managed to get them fantastic gifts and a Christmas tree and decorations," Lee said. 'More requests' Meanwhile, Taunton's charity appeal Christmas Sparkle said their demand has risen sharply over the last couple of years, with 500 presents given out in 2015 to 10,000 last year. They said they are expecting even higher demand this year. Gill Harrison, founder and manager at Christmas Sparkle, said she believes the cost of living crisis is increasing the demand for their services. "When we started the project in 2015, we gave out 500 individual gifts. Last year, it was around 2,300 parcels, that's about 10,000 individual gifts," Harrison said. "We are expecting possibly even more requests this year. That's mostly because of the cost-of-living crisis." Harrison said they work with schools, social services, police, women's refuges and community nursing teams, which have all increased their referrals to Christmas Sparkle over the last few years. articles.title: Christmas shoebox appeal launches to help children
articles.summary: A gift-filled shoebox campaign launched for children who would otherwise go without this Christmas.

articles.titleTr: Christmas shoebox appeal launches to help children
articles.summaryTr: A gift-filled shoebox campaign launched for children who would otherwise go without this Christmas.
articles.articleText: Christmas shoebox appeal launches to help children - Published Children across Staffordshire who might otherwise go without a Christmas present are set to receive gift-filled shoeboxes through a new appeal encouraging residents to donate locally. The initiative, organised by World Give, is asking people to pick up empty shoeboxes from supermarkets, fill them with gifts and return them for distribution to families through schools, charities and Staffordshire County Council. Trustee Adam Contoret said the appeal was launched after the charity recognised growing levels of hardship closer to home. "We look around the shops, we see everyone going about their business, but you don't see the people that aren't there," he said. "There's people that would be buying Christmas presents, but they can't because they haven't got the money." Over the past 20 years, the charity has helped more than 100,000 children across the world by sending shoeboxes full of gifts. This year, however, it has turned its attention to supporting children and families in Staffordshire. "It's apparently one in seven children who won't get a formal gift-wrapped Christmas present under the tree at Christmas," Contoret said. "This year we're turning around. Charity begins at home. The boxes are being done in Staffordshire for Staffordshire kids." People will be able to collect empty shoeboxes from participating supermarkets, fill them while doing their shopping and return them to be distributed through schools and local charities. The appeal comes as a Family Action survey of 2,000 parents and carers found one in five had considered cancelling Christmas because they could not afford it, while one in nine said they would not be able to afford a Christmas present for their child. Contoret said schools and local charities were best placed to identify families who could benefit from the scheme and ensure gifts were distributed discreetly. "The schools know the families and they're the best place to hand those gifts over at the right time in a discreet and respectful way," he said. Students supporting the campaign said the shoeboxes could have a significant impact on children at Christmas. Noah said he would include practical items alongside gifts. "I think it's good to give things to everyone and relate it to the age groups," he said. "I would give them notepads, pens, calculators and a stationery set, for example pencil cases, rulers and protractors." Steven said the appeal could help children enjoy the festive season. "Christmas is a festive season of merriness, so if you don't have any presents, you don't feel that giving and love and you won't feel that much merrier," he said. Isabelle said receiving a gift-filled shoebox could help children feel valued. "They might feel special because they know someone actually put thought into putting stuff in the box for them, so they know that someone cares for them and they feel loved," she said. articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

articles.titleTr: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
articles.articleText: Release Number 9314-26 CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball October 26, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Through the MOU, the CFTC and NBA will better share information by regularly communicating and discussing matters relating to integrity, as well as maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. “I’m pleased the CFTC and NBA signed an MOU which continues the Commission’s commitment to increasing data sharing between the agency and professional sports leagues,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The NBA joins the MLB and NHL in taking a responsible step toward protecting sports integrity and market participants from abuses in prediction markets like insider trading and fraud. I thank NBA Commissioner Adam Silver for putting the integrity of professional basketball and America’s financial markets first and for working with the CFTC on this MOU.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9313-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud October 21, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against defendants Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC for their participation in a fraudulent retail forex scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented that participant funds would be used to trade retail forex, made material misrepresentations and omissions regarding the profitability of forex trading with them, and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying DePetrillo’s personal expenses, and trading in DePetrillo’s personal account. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,211,492 civil monetary penalty. The order also permanently enjoins the defendants from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2024 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9003-24] On Feb. 18, 2025, in a related criminal case, DePetrillo pleaded guilty to violating the Commodity Exchange Act in connection with the same conduct in the CFTC’s complaint. On July 23, 2025, the court sentenced him to nine years in prison and ordered him to pay $6,748,412 in restitution. The CFTC appreciates the assistance of the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Louisiana and the FBI New Orleans Division. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC’s Innovation Task Force Announces Agenda & Panelists for Inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC’s Innovation Task Force Announces Agenda & Panelists for Inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence
articles.articleText: Release Number 9312-26 CFTC’s Innovation Task Force Announces Agenda & Panelists for Inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence October 20, 2026 WASHINGTON—The CFTC’s Innovation Task Force today released the agenda for the inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence. Attendees will discuss how SI is being implemented on the frontier, the impact that SI and its proliferation will have on U.S. markets, and the Commission’s role in fostering responsible SI adoption and innovation while protecting market participants from novel and emergent risks. “Super intelligence is poised to transform our financial markets,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Through this inaugural Frontier Forum, we are bringing together leaders at the intersection of technology and finance to explore the opportunities and risks of super intelligence and help shape the next frontier of American financial innovation.” View the full agenda here. This meeting will be streamed live on CFTC.gov. Dial-in information can be found below. For highest quality, select a number nearest your current location. - New York: (646)-828-7666 - New Jersey: (551)-285-1373 - San Jose: (669)-254-5252 or (669)-216-1590 - US Toll Free: (833)-568-8864 or (833)-435-1820 - US Spanish Line: (646)-964-1167 or (415)-449-4000 - Webinar ID: 165 708 9557 - Passcode: 669856 - International Numbers Individuals with additional questions should contact Michael J. Passalacqua, who leads the Innovation Task Force. The views, opinions, and information expressed by the participants during this forum are solely those of the respective participant and do not reflect the views of the Commission, its staff, or the U.S. government. -CFTC-

news.titleTr: ABD seçimleri piyasaları nasıl etkileyecek? 5 sektör öne çıkıyor
news.summaryTr: ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak ara seçimler öncesinde piyasaların gözü Kongre'deki güç dengelerine çevrildi. Seçim sonuçlarının savunma, sağlık, bankacılık, kripto para ve yapay zeka sektörlerinde şirketlerin geleceğini ve yatırımcıların beklentilerini etkilemesi bekleniyor.
news.articleText: ABD seçimleri piyasaları nasıl etkileyecek? 5 sektör öne çıkıyor - ABD'de 3 Kasım'da yapılacak ara seçimler öncesinde piyasaların gözü Kongre'deki güç dengelerine çevrildi. Seçim sonuçlarının savunma, sağlık, bankacılık, kripto para ve yapay zeka sektörlerinde şirketlerin geleceğini ve yatırımcıların beklentilerini etkilemesi bekleniyor. ABD'de yaklaşan ara seçimler, yalnızca siyasi dengeler açısından değil, finans piyasaları ve büyük şirketlerin geleceği bakımından da kritik önem taşıyor. Demokratların Temsilciler Meclisi veya Senato'da çoğunluğu elde etmesi halinde federal harcamalar, şirket denetimleri ve düzenleyici politikalar üzerinde önemli değişiklikler yaşanabileceği değerlendiriliyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC'nin haberine göre, Kongre'deki güç dengelerinin değişmesi özellikle kamu harcamalarına ve federal düzenlemelere bağımlı sektörlerde yeni bir dönemin kapısını aralayabilir. Ancak Başkan Donald Trump'ın veto yetkisini koruyacak olması, olası politika değişikliklerinin kapsamını sınırlayabilir. Savunma sektöründe milyarlarca dolarlık bütçe Savunma sanayi, seçim sonuçlarından doğrudan etkilenebilecek sektörlerin başında geliyor. Satışlarının yaklaşık yüzde 70'ini ABD hükümetinden elde eden Lockheed Martin gibi şirketler için Kongre'nin bütçe kararları büyük önem taşıyor. Beyaz Saray, 2027 mali yılı için 1,5 trilyon dolarlık savunma bütçesi talep ederken, İran'la bağlantılı askeri operasyonlar için de 87,6 milyar dolarlık ek ödenek istedi. Demokratların Kongre'de güç kazanması halinde bazı askeri harcamaların daha fazla sorgulanabileceği, buna karşılık füze savunması ve nükleer modernizasyon gibi alanlarda iki partinin desteğinin devam edebileceği belirtiliyor. Sağlık şirketlerinde Medicaid belirsizliği Sağlık sektöründe ise federal Medicaid programına yönelik bütçe kesintileri öne çıkıyor. Trump yönetiminin 2025 yılında kabul edilen vergi ve harcama yasasının, 2034 yılına kadar Medicaid harcamalarını 911 milyar dolar azaltacağı hesaplanıyor. 2025 yılı prim gelirlerinin yüzde 75'ini Medicaid'den elde eden Molina Healthcare gibi şirketler, olası değişikliklerden etkilenebilecek kuruluşlar arasında bulunuyor. Demokratların Kongre'de çoğunluk sağlaması, sağlık harcamalarındaki kesintilerin ertelenmesine yönelik girişimleri artırabilir. Bununla birlikte sigorta şirketleri ve ilaç üreticileri üzerindeki denetimlerin de sıkılaşabileceği ifade ediliyor. Kripto para piyasasında düzenleme arayışı Kripto para sektöründe Coinbase ve Circle gibi şirketler, Kongre'den çıkacak düzenlemelere odaklanıyor. Trump yönetiminin desteklediği kripto para piyasasına ilişkin kapsamlı düzenlemenin Senato'da ilerleyememesi, sektörde belirsizliği artırmıştı. Demokratların güç kazanması halinde tüketici koruma kurallarının sıkılaştırılması, stablecoin ürünlerine yeni sınırlamalar getirilmesi ve kripto şirketlerinin daha kapsamlı denetlenmesi gündeme gelebilir. Bankalarda sermaye kuralları değişebilir Bankacılık sektöründe ise sermaye yeterliliğine ilişkin düzenlemeler yakından takip ediliyor. ABD'deki düzenleyici kurumlar, önerilen sermaye reformunun büyük bankaların sermaye gereksinimlerini yaklaşık yüzde 4,8 azaltabileceğini öngörüyor. Bu değişiklik, bankaların kredi verme kapasitesini ve hissedarlarına sağlayabilecekleri ödemeleri artırabilir. Ancak Kongre'deki yeni dengeler, düzenleyici kurumlar üzerindeki siyasi denetimi ve gelecekteki atamaları etkileyebilir. Yapay zeka yatırımlarında yeni maliyet riski Yapay zeka sektöründe veri merkezlerine yönelik yatırımlar ve enerji maliyetleri öne çıkıyor. Büyük teknoloji şirketlerinin 2027 yılına kadar sermaye projelerine 1 trilyon doların üzerinde harcama yapması planlanırken, veri merkezlerinin elektrik tüketimi ve altyapı üzerindeki etkileri tartışma yaratıyor. Demokratların Kongre'de güç kazanması halinde veri merkezlerinin şebeke yatırımlarından kaynaklanan maliyetlerin daha büyük bölümünü üstlenmesi gündeme gelebilir. Bu durum, teknoloji şirketlerinin yatırım maliyetlerini artırabilir. Borsada seçim sonrası yükseliş dikkat çekiyor Morgan Stanley'nin tarihsel verilere dayanan analizine göre, Cumhuriyetçi başkanların görevde olduğu ve Kongre'nin bölünmüş yapıda bulunduğu dönemlerde S&P 500 endeksi, ara seçimlerden sonraki bir yılda ortalama yüzde 23 yükseldi. Demokratların Kongre'nin her iki kanadını kontrol ettiği dönemlerde ise ortalama yükseliş yüzde 16 olarak gerçekleşti. Analistler, geçmişteki bu performansın gelecekte de tekrarlanacağının garanti olmadığını belirtirken, seçim sonuçlarının özellikle sektör bazında farklı etkiler yaratabileceğine dikkat çekiyor.

news.title: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked
news.summary: Neither government has confirmed who was responsible for the cyberattacks on Sunday evening.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked
news.summaryTr: Neither government has confirmed who was responsible for the cyberattacks on Sunday evening.
news.articleText: Fake nuclear warnings issued after Ukrainian and Russian air alert apps hacked - Published Ukraine and Russia have both said air alert apps were hacked on Sunday night after fake messages warning of attacks, including nuclear, were sent to users. Ukraine's widely used app sent red-level air raid warnings across the country, with additional warnings of radiation, chemical attacks, and street fighting sent to some residents in areas including Kyiv. A few hours later, Russian authorities said a similar app was hacked after fake alerts, some of which contained foul language, were triggered. It was unclear who was behind the cyberattacks or whether the two incidents were connected. Many Ukrainian citizens are used to receiving almost nightly alerts warning of incoming Russian missile and drone attacks. Some told the BBC that, four and a half years into the war, they have disabled the app altogether. After Sunday night's hack, the country's air force urged people to consult other official channels. In a post on Telegram, the air force said: "The Air Alarm application has probably been subjected to hostile interference. There is no radiation threat! Stay calm and follow our updates on our [Telegram] channel." The government said it had temporarily disabled the app for maintenance, saying it had "apparently been compromised". Some of the fake warnings were written in Russian, which would have alerted many users to the fact they were not legitimate. But Olena, a Kyiv resident, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme she had been alarmed, saying: "The first thought was 'oh my god, I'm not prepared for this'. "I'm prepared for blackouts, for a cut in central heating and water supply, but not for nuclear attack." Olena says her husband then received alerts for "street fighting attacks in Kyiv" and another alert, written in Russian. "After that I understood that somebody had attacked the app, because all notifications we get in Ukrainian." In Russia, the government said one of its air raid alert apps had also been targeted by "a massive cyberattack", which sent "fake information to the public". A purported screenshot of a fake alert was shared on Telegram by Atesh, a partisan Ukrainian group operating inside Russian-held territory. It warned some users that "nuclear warheads mounted on P1-Suns [a Ukrainian attack drone] had been launched at all regions of Russia". The alert, which included profanities, opened with a message telling residents there was a "risk of [things] getting lively" and told them to "stock up urgently on food for three weeks and hide". On Monday morning there was no sense the messages had caused widespread panic in Russia and the incident did not feature prominently on media outlets. Asked about the breach, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov did not address it specifically but said all Russian government internet resources were "one way or another... under constant cyberattacks", including the presidential site, which is targeted "round the clock". He said the proliferation of AI technology was contributing to an increase in cyberattacks. Russia's emergencies ministry said on Monday that the app's "full functionality will be restored by the end of the day" and the hack had not impacted the wider alert system. While both Russia and Ukraine are widely believed to carry out cyberattacks against one another, the informal language used in the hoax alerts on Sunday pointed to so-called hacktivist groups, which could be aligned to Moscow or Kyiv but are not formally directed by either government. Those responsible for the hack on Russia's system have likely had the capability to launch such an attack for some time but decided to hold off until Ukraine's alert app was compromised, cyber experts told the BBC. Oleksander Merezhko, chair of the foreign affairs committee in the Ukrainian parliament, said the attack did not cause panic or extreme reactions. Merezhko told the BBC that Ukrainians, especially in Kyiv, were used to "practically non-stop alerts", adding "this message was in Russian language which immediately aroused suspicions". He continued: "It's a very unpleasant fact but it is part of cyber war and people in Ukraine understand that. It is possible and we are quite prepared for such possibilities." Herbert Lin, a senior research scholar for cyber policy and security at Stanford University, told BBC World Service's Newsday programme: "I think it's the first time [a hack of this kind] happened to an official Ukrainian information app, but I suspect it won't be the last." The alerts in Ukraine were sent minutes before the end of a localised ceasefire in Ukraine's frontline Kherson region, which was implemented last Tuesday. It had been brokered in part by US First Lady Melania Trump to allow civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Fighting continued elsewhere while the Kherson ceasefire was in place. In the city of Dnipro alone, 15 people were killed in an attack on a train platform on Thursday. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. Additional reporting by Jamie Whitehead and Helen Davidson Related topics - Published16 hours ago

news.summaryTr: Türk seramik sektörünün uluslararası buluşması UNICERA İstanbul, 37’nci kez kapılarını açtı. 220’den fazla firma ve 700’ü aşkın markanın yer aldığı fuar, yeni ihracat fırsatlarına ve ticari iş birliklerine ev sahipliği yapıyor.
news.articleText: Türk seramiği İstanbul’da dünyayla buluştu - Türk seramik sektörünün uluslararası vitrini UNICERA İstanbul – Uluslararası Seramik Banyo Mutfak Fuarı, 2-6 Kasım 2026 tarihleri arasında İstanbul Fuar Merkezi’nde 37’nci kez kapılarını açtı. Dünyanın önde gelen seramik fuarları arasında yer alan organizasyon, 220’den fazla katılımcı firmayı ve 700’den fazla markayı sektör profesyonelleriyle buluşturdu. Yaklaşık 18 ülkeden uluslararası katılımcının yer aldığı fuarda, 105 ülkeden yaklaşık 60 bin ziyaretçinin ağırlanması hedefleniyor. - Türk seramik sektörünün üretim, tasarım ve ihracat gücünü uluslararası pazarlara taşıyan UNICERA İstanbul; yeni teknolojilere, yenilikçi ürünlere ve ticari iş birliklerine ev sahipliği yapıyor. Seramik, banyo ve mutfak sektörlerinin en önemli uluslararası buluşmalarından biri olan UNICERA İstanbul – Uluslararası Seramik Banyo Mutfak Fuarı, İstanbul Fuar Merkezi’nde düzenlenen törenle kapılarını açtı. İlk kez 1988 yılında gerçekleştirilen ve bu yıl 37’nci kez sektör profesyonellerini ağırlayan fuar, seramik kaplama malzemelerinden banyo ve mutfak ürünlerine, yapı kimyasallarından ileri üretim teknolojilerine kadar geniş bir ürün yelpazesini ziyaretçilerle buluşturuyor. UNICERA Uluslararası Fuarcılık A.Ş. tarafından düzenlenen ve ED Fuarcılık organizasyonunda gerçekleştirilen fuar, Türkiye Seramik Federasyonu (TSF) ve Tesisat İnşaat Malzemecileri Derneği (TİMDER) iş birliğiyle hayata geçirildi. Katılımcı firmaların yaklaşık yarısının ilk kez yer aldığı organizasyon, uluslararası alıcılarla Türk üreticiler arasında yeni ticari bağlantıların kurulmasını hedefliyor. Ticaret Bakanlığı tarafından yüzde 70 oranında prestijli yurt içi fuar katılım desteği kapsamına alınan UNICERA İstanbul, 6 Kasım’a kadar ziyaretçilerini ağırlayacak. Açılış töreninde konuşan kamu ve sektör temsilcileri, Türk seramik sektörünün küresel rekabet gücünün artırılması, ihracat pazarlarının çeşitlendirilmesi ve UNICERA İstanbul’un uluslararası konumunun güçlendirilmesi gerektiğine dikkat çekti. UNICERA, ihracat potansiyelimizi güçlendiren stratejik bir platform CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ticaret Bakan Yardımcısı Volkan Ağar, UNICERA İstanbul’un Türk seramik sektörünün uluslararası pazarlardaki görünürlüğüne önemli katkılar sağladığını belirterek, “Bu yıl 37’nci kez kapılarını açan UNICERA İstanbul, seramik, banyo ve mutfak sektörlerini aynı çatı altında buluşturan Türkiye’nin önde gelen uluslararası ihtisas fuarlarından biri. 128 ülkeden yaklaşık 90 bin ziyaretçinin beklendiği organizasyon, yeni ticari iş birliklerinin kurulması ve ihracat potansiyelimizin güçlendirilmesi açısından stratejik bir platform. Bakanlık olarak fuarlarımızın daha fazla uluslararası alıcıyı ülkemize çekmesi ve İstanbul’un küresel fuarcılıktaki konumunun güçlenmesi için desteğimizi sürdüreceğiz. Türk seramik sektörünün üretim birikimini yenilikçi tasarım, markalaşma ve sürdürülebilirlikle daha ileriye taşıyacağına inanıyoruz.” dedi. Türkiye’nin fuarları büyüyor, üretim gücü dünyaya açılıyor Türkiye İhracatçılar Meclisi (TİM) Başkanı Mustafa Gültepe, fuarların Türkiye’nin üretim ve ihracat gücünün dünyaya tanıtılmasında önemli rol oynadığını vurgulayarak, “UNICERA İstanbul’un 37’nci kez düzenlenmesini son derece kıymetli buluyorum. Fuarlar, Türkiye’nin ihracatının ve ticaretinin gelişmesine büyük katkı sağlıyor. Avrupa’da fuarlar küçülürken Türkiye’de büyüyen ve gelişen organizasyonlara tanıklık ediyoruz. Seramik sektörümüz, güçlü üretim altyapısı, markalaşma ve tasarım kabiliyetiyle önemli bir konumda bulunuyor. Net ihracatçı yapısıyla ülkemize değer katan sektörümüzün rekabet gücünü yeniden artırması büyük önem taşıyor. UNICERA gibi köklü organizasyonlar, sektörümüzün dünyayla buluşması ve yeni ticari fırsatlar oluşturması açısından vazgeçilmez. Bu vizyonu 37 yıl önce ortaya koyan herkese teşekkür ediyorum.” dedi. UNICERA, sektörün dönüşümünde önemli bir kilometre taşı UNICERA Uluslararası Fuarcılık A.Ş. Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı ve TİM Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Erdem Çenesiz, fuarın sektörün markalaşmasına ve uluslararası rekabet gücüne katkısına dikkat çekerek, “UNICERA, bugün Avrupa’nın en büyük iki seramik fuarından biri. Bu başarı, sektörümüzün ortak emeğinin ve yıllardır sürdürülen kararlılığın sonucu. Artık yalnızca fiyat, tasarım veya inovasyon tek başına yeterli değil. Ürünlerimizi doğru kitlelerle buluşturmak, üretim gücümüzü ve teknolojik yetkinliğimizi dünyaya anlatmak zorundayız. İşte bu nedenle UNICERA’dayız. Sektörümüzden gelen talepler doğrultusunda fuarımızın iki yılda bir, bahar aylarında düzenlenmesi kararı alındı. Bir sonraki buluşmamızı 2028 yılının baharında gerçekleştireceğiz. Bu süreci verimliliğimizi artırmak, markalarımızı güçlendirmek ve rekabet gücümüzü geliştirmek için değerlendireceğiz.” dedi. Türk seramiği dünyayla buluşuyor Seramik Sağlık Gereçleri Üreticileri Derneği Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı ve Türkiye Seramik Federasyonu (TSF) Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Yardımcısı Enver Sever, UNICERA İstanbul’un Türk seramik sektörünün uluslararası konumunu güçlendirdiğini belirterek, “1988 yılından bu yana düzenlenen UNICERA, bugün dünyanın önde gelen seramik, banyo ve mutfak fuarları arasında yer alıyor. Burada yalnızca yeni ürün ve koleksiyonlarımızı tanıtmıyor, Türkiye’nin sanayi birikimini, mühendislik yetkinliğini, tasarım gücünü ve ihracat vizyonunu da dünyayla buluşturuyoruz. Sektörümüzün geleceğinde yeşil dönüşüm, dijitalleşme, inovasyon, markalaşma ve yeni ihracat pazarları belirleyici olacak. Daha fazla üretmek kadar yüksek katma değer yaratmaya da odaklanmalıyız. UNICERA’nın bu ortak vizyonu güçlendirerek sektörümüz için yeni fırsatlara ve kalıcı iş birliklerine kapı açmasını diliyoruz.” dedi. Sektörümüzün ortak hafızası ve geleceği Tesisat İnşaat Malzemecileri Derneği (TİMDER) Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Çiğdem Aras, UNICERA İstanbul’un sektörün ortak emeğiyle büyüyen köklü bir marka olduğunu belirterek, “UNICERA İstanbul’un 37 yıllık yolculuğunda fabrikalarımızın büyümesi, dünyaya açılan markalarımız, yeni teknolojilerimiz ve kuşaklar boyunca aktarılan büyük bir emek var. Bu fuar, sektörümüzün ortak hafızasıdır. Burada kurulan her yeni bağlantı, açılan her yeni pazar ve doğan her iş birliği, geleceğimize yapılan bir yatırımdır. Dünyada ticaret ve fuarcılık değişse de ticaretin merkezinde hâlâ insan bulunuyor. UNICERA, bizlere yüz yüze buluşma ve güvene dayalı ilişkiler geliştirme imkânı sunuyor. Hedefimiz, daha fazla uluslararası ziyaretçiyi ağırlayan, ihracat bağlantılarını güçlendiren ve yenilikçi ürünlerin öne çıktığı bir UNICERA’yı gelecek kuşaklara bırakmak.” dedi. “Katılımcıların yaklaşık yarısı ilk kez yer alıyor” ED Fuarcılık Kurucu Ortağı Dilek Soydan, UNICERA İstanbul’un uluslararası katılımcı yapısına ve organizasyonun ulaştığı büyüklüğe ilişkin bilgi vererek, “UNICERA İstanbul’un 37’nci buluşmasını gerçekleştirmekten büyük mutluluk duyuyoruz. ED Fuarcılık olarak beşinci yılımızda böylesine köklü ve sektörünün lideri olan bir organizasyonu düzenlemek bizim için büyük bir gurur. Bu yıl 220’den fazla katılımcı firmayı ve 700’den fazla markayı ağırlıyoruz. Katılımcılarımızın neredeyse yarısının fuarımıza ilk kez katılıyor olması da bizim için son derece değerli. Yaklaşık 18 farklı ülkeden uluslararası katılımın gerçekleştiği organizasyonumuzda 70’den fazla yabancı firma yer alıyor. Fuarımıza sahip çıkan, emek veren ve sektörümüzün bu önemli buluşmasına katkı sağlayan tüm katılımcılarımıza ve paydaşlarımıza teşekkür ediyoruz.” dedi.
